4. Muret midis dhomave me gips dhe lesh guri
5. Tavan varur gipsi
6. Tualet dhe Lavanderi do shtrohen dhe vishen me pllaka
7. Ambiente ndenje dhe fjetje do shtrohen me parket dru inxhinierik 14mm.
8. Sistem Kondicionimi Qendror (pra nuk ka kompresore ne ballkone). Sistemi kondicionimit me shume mundesi do jete Daikin ose Mitsubishi.
9. Sistemi hidraulik do jete me VALSIR.
10. Sistemi elektrik të ardhura nga brendet më të mira ndërkombëtare

description_en: Apartment for sale 1+1 in the Center! - Very neat floor plan - It is as tall as an apartment from floor to ceiling (3m) Apartment description: - 1 bedroom - 1 laundry room + drying room - 1 living room + 1 kitchen - 1 toilet - 1 corridor - 1 balcony - TOTAL SEP: 120 m2 - SEP BALCONY: 6.53m2 - SEP Net: 101.75mw - FLOOR: 8 Residential - FLOORS OF THE BUILDING: 20 - New building - Year of construction: 2023 - ELEVATOR: 4 elevators of the KONE brand, speed 3 m/s, each of which has a capacity of 13 people - MORTGAGE: NO - Private GARAGE NO Features: - Fantastic layout - 4 elevators of the KONE brand, speed 3 m/s, each of which has a capacity of 13 people 1. Height of the Apartment = 270cm - 275cm, which is designed with a suspended ceiling, but the height from the floor to the ceiling is 3 meters. 2. METRA Thermal Aluminum Facade and SN63 GUARDIAN Triplex Glass. Openings are floor-ceiling Window system with Antiribalt. 3. Separation walls between the apartments with 15cm lightened full brick and 7.50cm gypsum wall (5cm profile and stone wool + 2 2.50cm gypsum panels) on two sides, so 30cm in total. 4. Walls between rooms with gypsum and stone wool 5. Gypsum suspended ceiling 6. Toilets and Laundry will be laid and covered with tiles 7. Living and sleeping areas will be laid with 14mm engineered wood parquet. 8. Central Air Conditioning System (so there are no compressors on the balcony). The air conditioning system will most likely be Daikin or Mitsubishi. 9. The hydraulic system will be with VALSIR. 10. Electric system income from the best international brands
